FROM rust:alpine AS build

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git

# Install other relevant packages
RUN apk add --no-cache clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release

CMD ["/bin/sh"]

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git and other essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]
```

ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin

    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git and other essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]
```

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git and other essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git and other essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin

**Important Instructions:**
- Do not add '|| exit 0' to commands you run directly on the Linux terminal. Only add it to RUN instructions within the Dockerfile.

**Example Dockerfile Template:**
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.10-slim  # Adjust the base image based on the project's language and dependencies

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other relevant packages (e.g., gcc, bash)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y gcc bash && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

CMD ["/bin/bash"]
```

typst-typst-6652/Dockerfile
```
FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]
```

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]

ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other relevant packages (e.g., gcc, bash)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y gcc bash && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

CMD ["/bin/bash"]
```

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]

WORKDIR /app

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \

    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \

    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]
```

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]

RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other relevant packages (e.g., gcc, bash)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y gcc bash && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

CMD ["/bin/bash"]

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]

FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]

**Important Instructions:**
- Do not add '|| exit 0' to commands you run directly on the Linux terminal. Only add it to RUN instructions within the Dockerfile.

**Example Dockerfile Template:**
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.10-slim  # Adjust the base image based on the project's language and dependencies

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other relevant packages (e.g., gcc, bash)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y gcc bash && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

CMD ["/bin/bash"]
```

typst-typst-6652/Dockerfile
```
FROM rust:alpine

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install essential packages
RUN apk add --no-cache git clang lld musl-dev openssl-dev openssl-libs-static

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/typst/typst.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/typst

# Fetch dependencies
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse \
    cargo fetch

# Build the project
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/git/db \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/cache \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cargo/registry/index \
    cargo build --release || exit 0

# Run tests
CMD ["cargo", "test"]
```
